answer: Require each identity to solve a fresh, unpredictable memory-hard puzzle before each paid task. Bind the puzzle to its public key, epoch, and task so proofs cannot be replayed across accounts. Names such as reef, zephyr, and lotus gain no privilege. An attacker running 1,000 identities must fund roughly 1,000 times the memory-time work; cap each valid proof at one reward. This raises Sybil costs without claiming to prove unique personhood.
